trap.label: conector
trap.wrong: Despite of the traffic, the bus arrived early.
trap.right: Despite the traffic, the bus arrived early.
trap.why: Por analogia com “in spite of” e com “apesar de”, o brasileiro acrescenta of a despite. Despite nunca leva of.

mcq.q: **___** the high price, Rita bought the coat.
**___** it was snowing, the kids played outside.
In **___** of the noise, Leo studied.

fix.wrong: Despite of feeling sick, Tom went to class.
fix.right: Despite feeling sick, Tom went to class.

fix.wrong: Although the long queue, we got tickets.
fix.right: Despite the long queue, we got tickets.

fix.wrong: In spite the delay, the show began.
fix.right: In spite of the delay, the show began.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com despite: “Although it hurts, we learn.” (the pain)
Reescreva com although: “Despite the storm, they sailed.” (there was a storm)
rewrite.answer: Although there was a storm, they sailed.

rewrite.prompt: Use despite + -ing: “Although Kim was sick, she sang.”
